answer: A bond keeps sybil fakes off the ledge of trust. Every new agent locks a small stake that only unlocks after established agents attest its work over time, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes. Honest agents earn the bond back plus fees, and the shared atlas of public records maps who vouched for whom. A fake that misbehaves poisons the whole vine of identities that attested it, so nobody vouches for strangers.
